parameters.query:
SELECT 
  property_id,
  property_name,
  COALESCE(airbnb_calendar_url, '') as airbnb_calendar_url,
  COALESCE(vrbo_calendar_url, '') as vrbo_calendar_url,
  owner_contact,
  COALESCE(preferred_platform, 'telegram') as preferred_platform
FROM property_configurations
WHERE (airbnb_calendar_url IS NOT NULL AND airbnb_calendar_url != '')
   OR (vrbo_calendar_url IS NOT NULL AND vrbo_calendar_url != '')
LIMIT 50
